The `flaky` service restarts because its command always exits with an error, and `restart: always` brings it back every time.

The command at `docker-compose.yml:4` prints `fatal: missing DATABASE_URL` to stderr and then runs `exit 3`. The service never connects to anything, so it fails immediately on every start.

The cause is that `DATABASE_URL` is never set. Line 7 defines `DATABASE_URL_HINT: "set DATABASE_URL"`, which is only a string. It does not define the variable the script checks for. To fix it, add `DATABASE_URL: <connection string>` under `environment`. The command as written will still exit 3 if the variable is missing, so the fix depends on the real service expecting that variable.

I did not change any files. The file also stores `API_SECRET` in plain text on line 8, which you may want to move into an `.env` file or a secret store.
